recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century soul music aesthetic featuring a large, high-contrast duotone portrait of a smiling man in a suit, overlaid with a smaller full-color inset photo and bold, multi-colored sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Large purple-tinted duotone portrait as the primary background element.
Small rectangular full-color inset in the bottom-left corner for temporal contrast.
Bold, blocky text elements framing the central figure.
High-key white background providing stark negative space on the right.
coreInvariants: Purple-blue duotone treatment on the main subject.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Main subject is a large, centered-left bust portrait; secondary subject is a small square inset at bottom-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large smiling face of the main subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large green name at top-left, moves to the face, down to the yellow title at bottom, then up to the tracklist on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space on the right side balances the dense imagery on the left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Purple/Indigo for the main duotone portrait.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal-green and bright yellow for primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark purple shadows and the blown-out white highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold condensed display face paired with a clean, legible body face for information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, blocky feel of the display text.
Provides the necessary weight and vintage grotesque feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a smiling man in a 1960s suit, applied with a deep purple and white duotone filter. The background should be pure white on the right side. Include a small, square, full-color inset photo of the same man with a beard and hat in the bottom-left corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, condensed sans-serif text in teal-green at the top-left. Add similar bold text in bright yellow at the bottom-center. Place a vertical list of black text on the right side in a clean, medium-weight sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the main portrait purple duotone?
Is the display text condensed and bold?
Is there a clear white negative space on the right?
Is the inset photo in full color?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names and track titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the eyes of the main subject.
Check that the duotone highlights are bright white.
Verify the inset photo has a distinct border or clear separation.
Confirm the yellow text at the bottom is legible against the dark suit.
recipe.reuseFormula: Duotone Portrait + Bold Condensed Display Type + White Negative Space + Color Inset = Retro Soul Aesthetic
